classification.difficultyReason: For the L-shaped boundary, recognise that the unlabelled horizontal segments together equal the full width and the vertical segments together equal the full height, allowing perimeter calculation without individual missing lengths.

content.prompt: Calculate the perimeter of these shapes.

spec.description: Horizontal rectangle with full-width dimension above and full-height dimension on the left.
spec.mathematics: Opposite sides of the rectangle are equal; supplied dimensions are 5/7 cm and 2/7 cm.

spec.description: Upright triangle with one equality tick on each side and an external right-side dimension arrow.
spec.mathematics: All three sides have length 15/9 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Side measurement and equality marks only.

spec.description: Six-edge L-shaped polygon, tall arm on the left, with full-height and full-width dimension arrows.
spec.mathematics: Total height is 4/9 cm and total width is 14/9 cm. Drawing proportions do not establish any further lengths.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the two supplied full-extent dimensions are visible.

answer.worked:
The horizontal edges total twice the full width, and the vertical edges total twice the full height.

$\begin{align*}P&=\frac{14}{9}+\frac{14}{9}+\frac{4}{9}+\frac{4}{9}\\P&=\frac{36}{9}\\P&=4\,\mathrm{cm}\end{align*}$
